label: The Node CLI never spawns a daemon on demand: without a live daemon it silently degrades to an in-process local scorer (exit 0, status ok, degraded true, source local-scorer, no freshness), while --warm-only fails closed with ENOENT on the socket (exit 75); a cold runner without the launcher daemon therefore scores with a different engine instead of paying a cold start, and the battery's freshness-in-(live|stale) envelope rule is the honesty guard.

Trusted live cross-path top-1 agreement on the 49-prompt stride sample of the 217-prompt union is 44/49 (89.8%) with all rows envelope-trusted, while the same prompts under the degraded fallback would score 34/49 (69.4%); the parity gate's expected divergence budget on this corpus is ~10% and must refuse degraded envelopes.

The 5 trusted divergences fall into 3 classes, and 3 of 5 (rr-iter2-022, rr-iter3-106, rr-iter3-116, all memory:save vs system-spec-kit flips) have no entry in the reviewed 73-entry ledger by row id or exact prompt text; rr-iter3-081 is ledgered with matching values; the rr-iter3-061 entry is stale on the Python side (ledger local=system-deep-loop vs live Python sk-code, which now reaches the gold the ledger says neither side reaches).

The 0.82 floor dominates the union too but the battery overstates exact ties: 28/49 sample rows (57%) touch 0.82 in the top two on both paths while exact top-2 ties are 5/49 (10%) with identical sets on both paths (battery: 11/21 touch, 5/21 exact), and one live divergence is a tie-order flip at the floor.

Union-sample live costs are Node 282 ms mean (median 262, max 504) vs Python per-process 827 ms mean (median 807, max 1291), ~2.9x within the pass, but the same Python workload measured 404 ms mean minutes earlier, so absolute cost is load-sensitive; a naive full-217 both-paths pass extrapolates to ~4.0 min.

Both reproducing divergences show a Node ranking anomaly: #2 confidence exceeds #1 (0.9417 > 0.8398 on rr-iter2-022; 0.8899 > 0.8364 on rr-iter3-061), and in both cases Python's top-1 is the higher-confidence skill; top-1 stays the right parity predicate while confidence belongs in the diagnostic record.
